BiblicalUsage: Alarm is the sound of this word. When the ark of God came into the camp, the Philistines said, Woe unto us, who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? and Ezekiel cried, Woe, woe unto thee, O Jerusalem, after all thy wickedness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe woe is the sound of a heart that sees judgment coming: the Philistines cried it when the ark arrived, and the prophet cried it over a city that would not turn.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
